# stb_image dependency

Original PNG/JPEG decoder from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit `013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083`.

The unmodified header includes its MIT/public-domain license. Veldren uses the decoder; asset semantics, validation, color handling, mip generation, variant selection and ownership remain Veldren C++ code.
